title: Sunsuma a Ɛwɔ Ahengua no Akyi
intro: Wogyina tete ahenni a ɛyɛ den bi ahemfie mu, baabi a sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi abɔ wɔn ho dawuru sɛ onyame wɔ ɔman no nyinaa so. Sodifo yi nkyɛn na akoa bi a ɔde ne ho ama, a wɔde ahenni no mu apɛde akɛse a ɛsen biara ahyɛ no nsa. Wɔbom bɔ pɔw na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe, na wɔpow sɛ wobetie ɔbɔfo bi a wɔsomaa no sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan no kɔkɔbɔ. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a na saa akoa nokwafo yi yɛ?
clues: Na mete ahenni a ɛyɛ den a obi a ɔwɔ tumi a ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onyame wɔ nnipa no nyinaa so na odi so mu.
Mesom sɛ sodifo yi somfo a wogye no di, na midii wɔn apɛde ne ahyɛde biara ho dwuma.
Bere a Allah somafoa bi baa yen asaase so frɛɛ yɛn kɔɔ nokorɛ mu no, me ne me sodifoɔ no ampene so sɛ yɛbɛtie.
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ mensɔ ogya kɛse na mensiesie dɔte birikisi mma adansi kɛse bi.
Ná me sodifo no pɛ sɛ osi ɔdan atenten bi a ɛkorɔn araa ma ebedu ɔsoro ankasa.
Awiei koraa no, wɔprapraa me ne me sodifo, yɛn asraafo dɔm no kɔe na memee wɔ po no mu bun mu.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
